notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! 

As you may have seen, I postponed the release date of Equilibrium Realms. It will now ( potentially, this can still change ) be released on November 1st. I recently collected feedback of the current state of the game and it has been really positive and encouraging so far. 

That's why I would like to spend as much time implementing elements to maximize the experience of the players !

Also, I have had many ideas (some of which were suggested to me) for new features, and they have great potential. I'll try to post stuff like this quite often, to make sure you don't think I put this game aside ( which is really not the case )

I hope you understand, and I hope to read your feedback in a few months !

See ya ! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Release date ! #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! 

Thank you very much for those who added Equilibrium Realms to your wishlist, I sincerly hope you will enjoy the game.

I have decided to release ER on August 1st, to make sure I can add more content.

However, I may postpone this date, if I believe there's not enough content for players to be satisfied with their investment.

In the meantime, I'm going to work hard to make that happen ( a.k.a no sleep for a while ).

See ya !
